top_story.headline: A quiet Monday: one HHS conflict-of-interest waiver, three House filings from one candidate, routine lobbying
top_story.dek: Nothing in today's filings, OGE summary or deterministic extras rises above routine.
paragraphs: OGE posted a conflict-of-interest waiver for Ronald Karlsberg at the Department of Health and Human Services on October 26. OGE does not post the waiver text, so the reason for it is not public yet.

The only House disclosures were three filings from Mr. Cristian Morales (CA43), two amendments and a candidate report, all filed October 23. No FARA filings, no presidential or vice-presidential 278-Ts and no pardon-lobbying filings were new today. The Senate disclosure check failed this run, so Senate filings are not covered (see the footer).

sections.headline: No FARA contacts today; one LDA filing names Todd Blanche
paragraphs: No FARA filings were new in the top-officials search. One quarterly LDA report names a top official in the issues it lists as lobbied.

items: Leadership Conference on Civil and Human Rights (in-house, 3rd Quarter report): the filing names Todd Blanche in its description of what was lobbied. The same description lists concerns with the blocking of senior officer promotions, Consumer Financial Protection Bureau policy and oversight, cryptocurrency regulation, and opposition to H.R. 7866, the "American Lending Fairness Act of 2026." LDA filing.

sections.headline: 11 new registrations led by Todd Strategy Group's health-care clients; 5 terminations
paragraphs: 87 LDA filings were posted since October 25: 55 3rd Quarter reports, 11 registrations, 6 3rd Quarter no-activity reports, 2 registration amendments, 2 3rd Quarter terminations, 2 3rd Quarter no-activity terminations and 1 3rd Quarter termination amendment (no activity). The remaining 7 are late-filed or amended reports for other quarters.

Todd Strategy Group filed six of the 11 registrations, all for health-care clients and all listing former congressional or HHS staff as covered positions. The registration for Healthcare Privacy Forum, LLC d/b/a Healthcare Trust Institute is that client's first-ever LDA registration. The table lists all registrations and terminations plus six activity reports with a signal. The other 65 activity reports are not listed.
